title: The Impossible Tower
summary: Hop across enemy platforms in time with the beat. Release and tap again at the peak to dash through gaps, gravity wells, and lightning-filled routes.
about: Hop across enemy platforms in time with the beat. Release and tap again at the peak to dash through gaps, gravity wells, and lightning-filled routes.
An independent mini game inspired by The Tower. Play the browser version, or explore the rest of Tower Arcade for another kind of challenge.

features.title: Rhythm and movement
features.text: Find a steady rhythm as you cross enemy platforms.

features.title: Hops and dashes
features.text: Time your inputs to clear gaps along the route.

features.title: Hazardous routes
features.text: Navigate gravity wells and lightning while keeping your momentum.

steps.title: Start hopping
steps.text: Hold Space or the touch control to hop across platforms.

steps.title: Time a dash
steps.text: Release and tap again at the peak to dash through a gap.

steps.title: Learn the route
steps.text: Use each attempt to improve your timing through the hazards.

controls.action: Hold to hop · Space or touch
Use the game’s menus to start a run and see its available options.

availability: Available to play in your browser on desktop and mobile. The Play button opens the game.
controlNote: The game’s own controls and menus provide any additional bindings.
